value.rationale: The fixed 2-by-5 nearest-neighbor ladder is a canonical ten-site routing network and the 10! census is a substantial exact benchmark for shortest serial SWAP-gate algorithms. Its four diameter antipodes and different, unique largest transportation-bound-defect partner distinguish worst total swap cost from worst bound failure, exposing a mathematically motivated limitation of a standard heuristic. These exact all-state metrics are not implied by simple symmetry, correctness, or the general lower bound; no all-n extrapolation is claimed.
